messages:
emma: Quick flag — saw ~12 inbound leads yesterday that stayed unassigned for 30+ mins. HubSpot shows 'Unassigned' and Salesforce never got created. Happened during the enrichment spike around 14:10 PST. Anyone else seeing this?

nick: yeah saw a blip in the routing metrics, throughput fell and RR queues piled up. Noticed enrich service returned 502s for a bit.

sarah: ow — any pattern on source? organic vs paid?

emma: mostly organic / forum signup. Not huge individually but spread across 20m.

ajay: looks like our current rule is: wait for enrichment payload to attach owner info, then assign via RR. If enrichment times out, we just leave it unassigned. No fallback.

nick: that explains it. We should probably have a short "assign grace window" — wait 2 min for enrichment, then assign to default pool owner to prevent leads going cold.

sarah: agree. Marketing ops want owner assigned ASAP. Can we make it a configurable TTL per source? Some partners prefer longer.

ajay: propose this quick patch:
```
1) Add a 120s TTL on enrichment wait in HubSpot workflow.
2) If enrichment not returned, set owner = "marketing_pool_default" and add tag "needs-enrichment".
3) Sync to SF as lead with Owner = marketing_pool_default.
4) On enrichment success later, update lead details but DO NOT reassign owner automatically.
```

nick: 👍 Also add a metric/alert: if >5 unassigned leads in >5min window, page ops channel.

emma: can we avoid causing churn in RR fairness? If we default-claim many leads, RR counters might skew. Maybe mark those as "grace-assigned" and exclude from RR weight for next 1 hour.

ajay: good call — we can set a flag `grace_assigned=true` and exclude from rotation for 1h. Implementation is trivial in the assignment service.

sarah: outward facing: need to update SLA doc for inbound handoff. Current says assignments within 15m — can we change to "Owner assigned within 2m if enrichment pending; otherwise default pool assignment after 2m"? Marketing legal wants explicit note about updates.

nick: I'll draft the snippet for the SLA page and send to you. Also adding a short runbook for ops to revert the default-owner rule if enrichment service is degraded.

emma: thanks. One more ask — can leads-bot post a daily digest for any leads that were grace_assigned so reps can review later?

leads-bot: daily_digest scheduled: 1) list of `grace_assigned` leads in last 24h 2) enrichment status 3) link to HS list view. /cc @emma

ajay: timeline: I can push a safe rollout tomorrow: 1) feature flag + metrics 2) enable TTL=120s for forum signups only 3) monitor 4) ramp to all sources if stable.

sarah: +1. If we see reassign churn, we'll revisit.

emma: perfect. Nick, can you update the SLA doc and set the alert? Ajay, put the flag behind FF and ping us when deployed. I'll coordinate comms with sales.

nick: on it, will have draft in ~40m.

ajay: deploying FF now to staging. I'll post logs in this thread when it's up.

leads-bot: deploy-bot: Feature flag `grace_assign_v1` toggled ON in staging at 1729124080.

emma: awesome — thanks everyone :rocket:
